title: Hollow Knight: Silksong Started as DLC for a $35,000 Kickstarter
hook:
In 2014 Team Cherry asked Kickstarter for 35,000 Australian dollars to make Hollow Knight, and promised backers a free DLC starring Hornet. That DLC became Silksong. What game kept you waiting the longest?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know Hollow Knight: Silksong started life as a piece of DLC promised to Kickstarter backers? In November two thousand fourteen a small Australian studio called Team Cherry put Hollow Knight on Kickstarter. The goal was just 35,000 Australian dollars. A month later the campaign closed at more than 57,000 dollars. Hollow Knight shipped and went on to sell millions of copies. Team Cherry then started work on a paid expansion starring Hornet. Original backers had been promised that expansion for free. But the project kept growing. On February fourteenth two thousand nineteen Team Cherry announced the DLC had become a full sequel called Silksong. Every original backer would still get it for free. Then came the wait. Silksong finally launched on September fourth two thousand twenty five, more than six years after that announcement. Now its first expansion, Sea of Sorrow, is on the way at no extra cost. This week Team Cherry announced a Cherry Time broadcast for today, promising an update on Sea of Sorrow and other announcements. A thirty five thousand dollar campaign turned into a sequel that fans waited on for more than six years. What game kept you waiting the longest? Follow for more gaming history.
